name: math-platform-monorepo
description: Enterprise Math Teacher Smart Platform Monorepo

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:course" "npm run dev:analytics"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/frontend && npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/user-service && npm install --prefix services/ai-service && npm install --prefix services/course-service && npm install --prefix services/analytics-service && npm run generate --prefix packages/database
scripts.postinstall: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/database
